plainTranslation: Your emotional needs clash at the root. You both feel strongly but in incompatible ways - what soothes one unsettles the other. Failure mode: two reactive people triggering each other with no neutral ground. Learn each other's actual needs instead of assuming yours apply; this one takes translation work.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Your emotional needs and habits keep missing each other. What soothes one of you unsettles the other. Learn each other's actual comfort, not the one you'd assume.
tension:
The harder part is that moods can start setting each other off. One person gets quiet and the other reads it as rejection. One person asks for closeness and the other feels crowded. One person tries to move on and the other feels dismissed. Suddenly the issue is not just what happened, but how both people felt about how it was handled.

Because this is emotional, it may not always make sense on paper. You can explain the facts perfectly and still feel bruised. That is what makes this contact tricky. The feelings are not always logical, but they are still real.
advice: Pause before you turn the mood into a story. Ask what is actually needed. This connection gets easier when both people stop treating sensitivity as an accusation.
summaryShort: Your emotional needs and habits keep missing each other.
